name: SAF AWS Onboarding – Partially Completed
description: Sent to the user when SAF AWS Onboarding completes with some failed child accounts.
subject: SAF AWS Onboarding Partially Completed
body:
SAF AWS Onboarding Partially Completed

Dear $__recipient.name,

Your AWS onboarding finished with partial success. The AWS SaaS Connector is configured and the source is created, but some target AWS accounts could not be deployed and need your attention.

Deployment status

Partially completed — review the failed child accounts below and take the recommended actions.

Onboarding summary

  • Source name: $sourceName
  • Source ID: $sourceId
    • #if($adminAccountId)
  • AWS management account: $adminAccountId
    • #end
  • Deployment status: Partially completed

Deployment statistics

#if($managementAccountSuccessful != $null)

Management account: #if($managementAccountSuccessful) Deployed successfully #{else} Deployment failed #end

#end
Child accounts
$!childAccountsTotal
  
Successful
$!childAccountsSuccessful
  
Failed
$!childAccountsFailed
#if($failedAccountIds && !$failedAccountIds.isEmpty())

Failed account IDs

$!childAccountsFailed child account#if($childAccountsFailed != 1)s#end failed deployment.

#set($shownIds = "") #set($remainingCount = 0) #foreach($accountId in $failedAccountIds) #if($foreach.count <= 100) #if($shownIds != "")#set($shownIds = "$shownIds, ")#end #set($shownIds = "$shownIds$accountId") #{else} #set($remainingCount = $remainingCount + 1) #end #end $shownIds#if($remainingCount > 0), and $remainingCount more — view in AWS#end

#elseif($childAccountsFailed && $childAccountsFailed > 0)

Failed account IDs

$!childAccountsFailed child account#if($childAccountsFailed != 1)s#end failed deployment. View the source in SailPoint for account-level details.

#end

Recommended actions

Some child AWS accounts could not be deployed successfully. Review AWS CloudTrail logs on the target system for failure details, verify AWS permissions and service control policies (SCPs), and retry deployment for the affected accounts from the source configuration page.

#set($url=$__global.productUrl + '/ui/a/admin/connections/sources/' + $sourceId)

View source in SailPoint

Important: If Agentic Fabric has already been activated for this AWS source, you cannot make onboarding changes through SAF. To troubleshoot or change the configuration, go to the underlying AWS source in Identity Security Cloud (ISC).

For detailed deployment and onboarding status, including account-level success or failure details, sign in to your AWS account and review the AWS onboarding logs.

Thank you for using SailPoint Identity Security Cloud.
